Vendored mainline Stella source (`stella/`): tag `7.0c`, the `emucore`
module plus the non-GUI parts of `common/` and `os/libretro/` that its
libretro build needs. GPL-2.0-or-later, not covered by the repo's MIT
`LICENSE`. [stella/NOTICE.md](stella/NOTICE.md) records the exact commit,

compiles.
